crashCases.before_commit: Source requires no interrupted effect or receipt, followed by the original request's first complete commit.
crashCases.torn_final_group: Source injects and syncs an incomplete final record; checks Store.Open repair separately, exact retained prefix, absent partial state/receipt, and subsequent complete commit.
crashCases.durable_before_install: Source terminates after actual durable submission and before installation; recovery must reconstruct the committed withdrawal and actual original receipt.
crashCases.installed_before_ack: Source checks the public installed withdrawal, then terminates before return; recovery and retry must retain that exact committed result.
crashCases.allRows: CombinedOutput waits/reaps before reopening. Service replay is compared against post-store-repair bytes and durable sequence; old registration history, task and grant state are retained.
crashCases.limitations: Deliberate process death and torn bytes only—not power-loss, hardware-durability or exactly-once delivery qualification.
